michelle: Posting the postmortem for today’s serving incident. RCA is here: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1832504321 (internal).
postmortem-bot: Document uploaded — https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/1832504321. Summary snippet and action table added. :page_with_curl:
sanjay: Ack. I’ll take ownership of the autoscaler misconfig fix. Will open a PR today and add rollout plan. @michelle please add me to the follow-up checklist.
dana: Ack. I’ll own the checkpoint audit + add a model-onboarding preflight to prevent stale checkpoints from being served.
tess: Adding this to the eng-sre board now. Can we set a follow-up checkpoint meeting in two weeks? :calendar:
michelle: Yes — scheduled follow-up: 2026-04-09 09:00 PT. Meeting link in the doc. Quick action items (copied from doc):
```
- ACTION-1 | Owner: sanjay | Fix autoscaler default min=0 -> min=1 for critical pools | Due: 2026-04-02
- ACTION-2 | Owner: dana   | Audit model checkpoint lifecycle, add preflight gating in onboarding | Due: 2026-04-05
- ACTION-3 | Owner: ops    | Add alert for checkpoint-version divergence and a runbook | Due: 2026-04-01
- ACTION-4 | Owner: tess   | Add perf/regression dashboard panels for the rollout path | Due: 2026-04-07
- CHECKPOINT | All owners | Short status update in the doc before EOD 2026-03-27
```
sanjay: ETA for the autoscaler patch is ~48hrs for PR + 1 week for staged rollout. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5421 :white_check_mark:
dana: Will start audit today and push a short confluence note with findings by Friday morning.
ops: Ops will add the alert + runbook. Expecting to have the alert firing on dev by tomorrow, prod the day after. Will tag oncall when enabled. @sanjay @dana please review the runbook once I drop it.
tess: :eyes: will join the follow-up and bring latency/cost numbers from the affected pools.
michelle: Thanks everyone — please ACK the doc and the action items. We’ll treat the follow-up on 2026-04-09 as the checkpoint to close this RCA. If you can’t make the meeting, leave a short status in the doc. Closing the publish notification here. :lock_with_ink_pen:
